## Exporting Your Data

To export your data, please follow the steps below:

1. Click on the Account icon in the top right corner and select Settings.
2. In the Settings window, go to the Data & Privacy tab — it's the third tab from the left.
3. Under "Export", check "Include attachments" if you want your files too. Exports larger than 2.5 GB are split into parts of up to 1,000 files.
4. Click Request export. You'll receive an email once your export is ready (usually within 24 hours).

Warning: The download link expires after 7 days. Once you've downloaded your archive, we recommend deleting it from shared computers.
